questions.question: A row of matchstick squares uses 4, 7, 10 matchsticks for pictures 1, 2 and 3. Describe the rule in two ways and find the matchsticks for picture 6.
questions.expected_answer: From one picture to the next: add 3 matchsticks, because each new square shares a side and needs only 3 new sticks. From the position: 3 times the picture number plus 1, the plus 1 being the left side of the first square. Picture 6: 3 times 6 plus 1 is 19, or 10 plus 3 plus 3 plus 3 is 19.

questions.question: A staircase of blocks has 1, 3, 6, 10 blocks in pictures 1 to 4. Explain how it grows and find the number of blocks in picture 6.
questions.expected_answer: Each picture adds a new column one block taller than the last, so the differences are 2, 3, 4 and the next are 5 and 6. Picture 5 has 10 plus 5, which is 15, and picture 6 has 15 plus 6, which is 21.

questions.question: Make up a geometric pattern of your own, write its first four numbers and describe its rule so that a friend could draw picture 5.
questions.expected_answer: Example: start with a cross of 5 dots and add one dot to the end of each of the four arms every time. The dots are 5, 9, 13, 17. Rule: add 4 dots each time, or 4 times the picture number plus 1. Picture 5 has 21 dots.
